study type: retrospective cohort study with a control group
exposure: Nitric Oxide (NO) inhalation therapy synthesized from atmospheric air (using AIT-NO-01 device)
Nitric Oxide (NO) inhalation therapy from cylinders (using NOXBOX Mobile device)
cohort: 90 children (28 newborns and 62 children older than 28 days) who underwent cardiac surgery, required mechanical controlled ventilation, and had precapillary pulmonary hypertension (PAPsys >= 35 mm Hg).
finding: NO inhalation therapy using the AIT-NO-01 device, which synthesizes NO from atmospheric air, demonstrated comparable effectiveness in reducing PAPsys and safety, and was associated with a shorter duration of mechanical controlled ventilation compared to NO supplied from cylinders.
